name: Kali Temple, Daltonganj
town_description: Medininagar, still widely known as Daltonganj, is the district headquarters of Palamu district in north-western Jharkhand, on the North Koel River. It is a former colonial administrative town with several INTACH-listed heritage buildings, a market hub for the surrounding countryside, and the gateway to the Palamu Tiger Reserve (Betla National Park) about 25-30 km away. It is well connected by road and rail (Daltonganj station) and hosts a cluster of local Hindu temples and mosques.

travel.airport: Birsa Munda Airport, Ranchi - the nearest major airport, roughly 165-190 km (verify exact distance)
travel.railway: Daltonganj (DTO) railway station on the Barkakana-Son Nagar line; regular connections to Ranchi, Gaya and Dehri
travel.road: On NH 39; connected by road to Ranchi, Garhwa, Latehar and Aurangabad (Bihar); local buses, autos and cabs available

visitor_information.best_time: October to March (pleasant winter); Navratri and Diwali/Kali Puja are the busiest periods
